chapterInfo.content:
7
Yakob mma a wɔaka no asefoɔ
1 # Gye 46.13; Num 26.23-24 Na Isakar mma ne: Tola, Pua, Yasub ne Simron, wɔyɛ baanan. 2Na Tola mma ne: Usi, Refaia, Yeriel, Yahmai, Yibsam ne Semuel, wɔn na wɔyɛ Tola mpanimfie atitire, mmarima akofoɔ, wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu. Dawid berɛ so na wɔn dodoɔ yɛ mpem aduonu mmienu ne ahansia. 3Na Usi mma ne: Yisrahia. Na Yisrahia mma ne: Mikael, Obadia ne Yoel, Yisia, wɔn baanum nyinaa yɛ atitire. 4Na wɔn a wɔka wɔn ho, sɛdeɛ wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ne wɔn mpanimfie teɛ no, akodie dɔm asafo, yɛ mmarima mpem aduasa nsia; na wɔwɔ yerenom ne mma pii. 5Na wɔn nuanom a wɔfiri Isakar mmusua nyinaa mu no nyinaa yɛ mmarima akofoɔ mpemaduɔwɔtwe nson a wɔkan wɔn sɛdeɛ wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ teɛ no.
6 # 1 Be 8.1-2; Gye 46.21 Benyamin deɛ: Bela, Beker ne Yediael, wɔyɛ baasa. 7Na Bela mma ne: Esbon, Usi, Usiel, Yerimot ne Iri, wɔyɛ baanum, wɔn mpanimfie so atitire, mmarima akofoɔ; wɔn dodoɔ yɛ mpemaduonu mmienu ne aduasa nnan. 8Na Beker mma ne: Semira, Yoas, Eliesa, Elioenai, Omri, Yeremot, Abia, Anatot ne Alamet. Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Beker mma. 9Na wɔn dodoɔ, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua ne wɔn mpanimfie atitire teɛ, yɛ mmarima akofoɔ mpemaduonu ne ahanu. 10Na Yediael mma ne: Bilhan. Na Bilhan mma ne: Yeus, Benyamin, Ehud, Kenaana, Setan, Tarsis ne Ahisahar. 11Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Yediael mma, sɛ wɔn agyanom atitire teɛ, mmarima akofoɔ mpemdunson ne ahanu, nnipa a wɔtumi kɔ ɔsa. 12Na Supim ne Hupim yɛ Ir mma. Husim yɛ Aher mma.
13 # Gye 46.24 Naftali mma ne: Yahsiel, Guni, Yeser ne Salum, Bilha mma.
14 # Num 26.29-33 Manase mma ne: Asriel a ne mpena woo no maa no. Na ne mpena Aramni woo Makir a ɔyɛ Gilead agya. Na Makir waree Hupim ne Supim nuabaa a ne din de Maaka. 15#Num 27.1 Na ne babarima a ɔtɔ so mmienu din de Selofehad; na Selofehad nyaa mmammaa. 16Na Makir yere Maaka woo ɔbabarima a ɔtoo no din Peres, na ne nua din de Seres. Na ne mma ne: Ulam ne Rakem. 17Na Ulam mma ne: Bedan. Yeinom ne Manase ba Makir ba Gilead mma. 18Na ne nuabaa Moleket woo Isod ne Abi-eser ne Mahla. 19Na Semida mma ne: Ahian, Sekem, Likhi ne Aniam.
20 # Num 26.35 Na Efraim mma ne: Sutela ne Bered, ne ba, ne Tahat, ne ba, ne Elada, ne ba, ne Tahat, ne ba, 21ne Sabad, ne ba, ne Sutela, ne ba, ne Eser ne Elad. Na Gad mmarima a wɔwoo wɔn asase no soɔ no kumm wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ wɔsiane kɔɔ sɛ wɔrekɔfa wɔn mmoakuo akɔ. 22Na wɔn agya Efraim gyam wɔn nna pii, na ne nuanom ba bɛkyekyeree ne werɛ. 23Na ɔne ne yere daeɛ, na ɔnyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima, na ɔtoo no din Beria, ɛfiri sɛ adebɔne na ɛbaa ne fie. 24Na ne babaa ne Seera a ɔkyekyeree anafoɔ ne atifi Bet-horon ne Usen-seera. 25Na ne ba ne Refa ne Resef, ne ba Tela, ne ba Tahan, 26#Num 1.10 ne ba Ladan, ne ba Amihud, ne ba Elisama, 27#Num 13.8 ne ba Nun, ne ba Yosua. 28#Yos 16.1, 10 Na wɔn agyapadeɛ ne wɔn tenabea ne Betel ne ɛho nkurowa, ne apueeɛ fam Naaran ne atɔeɛ fam Geser ne ɛho nkurowa ne Sekem ne ɛho nkurowa kɔduru Asa ne ɛho nkurowa. 29#Yos 17.11 Na Manase mma nkyɛn mu bi wowɔ Bet-sean ne ɛho nkurowa, Taanak ne ɛho nkurowa, Megido ne ɛho nkurowa, Dor ne ɛho nkurowa. Yeinom mu na Israel ba Yosef mma teɛ.
30 # Gye 46.17 Aser mma ne: Yimna, Yiswa, Yiswi, Beria ne wɔn nuabaa Sera. 31Na Beria mma ne: Heber ne Malkiel, ɔne Birsait agya. 32Na Heber woo Yaflet, Somer, Hotam ne wɔn nuabaa Sua. 33Na Yaflet mma ne: Pasak, Bimhal ne Aswat. Yeinom ne Yaflet mma. 34Na Semer mma ne: Ahi ne Rohga, Yehuba ne Aram. 35Na ne nua Helem mma ne Sofa, Yimna, Seles ne Amal. 36Sofa mma ne: Suah, Harnefer, Saulo, Beri ne Yimra; 37Beser, Hod, Sama, Silsa, Yitran ne Beera. 38Na Yeter mma ne: Yefune, Pispa ne Ara. 39Na Ula mma ne: Arah, Haniel ne Risia. 40Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Aser mma mpanimfie so atitire, mmarima akofoɔ a wɔayi wɔn, mmapɔmma mu atitire; na wɔn a wɔkan wɔn maa ɔsakorɔ sɛdeɛ wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ teɛ no yɛ mmarima mpemaduonu nsia.

Na Isakar mma ne: Tola, Pua, Yasub ne Simron, wɔyɛ baanan. Na Tola mma ne: Usi, Refaia, Yeriel, Yahmai, Yibsam ne Semuel, wɔn na wɔyɛ Tola mpanimfie atitire, mmarima akofoɔ, wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mu. Dawid berɛ so na wɔn dodoɔ yɛ mpem aduonu mmienu ne ahansia. Na Usi mma ne: Yisrahia. Na Yisrahia mma ne: Mikael, Obadia ne Yoel, Yisia, wɔn baanum nyinaa yɛ atitire. Na wɔn a wɔka wɔn ho, sɛdeɛ wɔn awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ne wɔn mpanimfie teɛ no, akodie dɔm asafo, yɛ mmarima mpem aduasa nsia; na wɔwɔ yerenom ne mma pii. Benyamin deɛ: Bela, Beker ne Yediael, wɔyɛ baasa. Na Bela mma ne: Esbon, Usi, Usiel, Yerimot ne Iri, wɔyɛ baanum, wɔn mpanimfie so atitire, mmarima akofoɔ; wɔn dodoɔ yɛ mpemaduonu mmienu ne aduasa nnan. Na Beker mma ne: Semira, Yoas, Eliesa, Elioenai, Omri, Yeremot, Abia, Anatot ne Alamet. Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Beker mma. Na wɔn dodoɔ, sɛdeɛ wɔn mmusua ne wɔn mpanimfie atitire teɛ, yɛ mmarima akofoɔ mpemaduonu ne ahanu. Na Yediael mma ne: Bilhan. Na Bilhan mma ne: Yeus, Benyamin, Ehud, Kenaana, Setan, Tarsis ne Ahisahar. Yeinom nyinaa yɛ Yediael mma, sɛ wɔn agyanom atitire teɛ, mmarima akofoɔ mpemdunson ne ahanu, nnipa a wɔtumi kɔ ɔsa. Na Supim ne Hupim yɛ Ir mma. Husim yɛ Aher mma.
Naftali mma ne: Yahsiel, Guni, Yeser ne Salum, Bilha mma.
Manase mma ne: Asriel a ne mpena woo no maa no. Na ne mpena Aramni woo Makir a ɔyɛ Gilead agya. Na Makir waree Hupim ne Supim nuabaa a ne din de Maaka. Na ne babarima a ɔtɔ so mmienu din de Selofehad; na Selofehad nyaa mmammaa. Na Makir yere Maaka woo ɔbabarima a ɔtoo no din Peres, na ne nua din de Seres. Na ne mma ne: Ulam ne Rakem. Na Ulam mma ne: Bedan. Yeinom ne Manase ba Makir ba Gilead mma. Na ne nuabaa Moleket woo Isod ne Abi-eser ne Mahla. Na Semida mma ne: Ahian, Sekem, Likhi ne Aniam.
Na Efraim mma ne: Sutela ne Bered, ne ba, ne Tahat, ne ba, ne Elada, ne ba, ne Tahat, ne ba, ne Sabad, ne ba, ne Sutela, ne ba, ne Eser ne Elad. Na Gad mmarima a wɔwoo wɔn asase no soɔ no kumm wɔn, ɛfiri sɛ wɔsiane kɔɔ sɛ wɔrekɔfa wɔn mmoakuo akɔ. Na wɔn agya Efraim gyam wɔn nna pii, na ne nuanom ba bɛkyekyeree ne werɛ. Na ɔne ne yere daeɛ, na ɔnyinsɛnee, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima, na ɔtoo no din Beria, ɛfiri sɛ adebɔne na ɛbaa ne fie. Na ne babaa ne Seera a ɔkyekyeree anafoɔ ne atifi Bet-horon ne Usen-seera. Na ne ba ne Refa ne Resef, ne ba Tela, ne ba Tahan, ne ba Ladan, ne ba Amihud, ne ba Elisama, ne ba Nun, ne ba Yosua. Na wɔn agyapadeɛ ne wɔn tenabea ne Betel ne ɛho nkurowa, ne apueeɛ fam Naaran ne atɔeɛ fam Geser ne ɛho nkurowa ne Sekem ne ɛho nkurowa kɔduru Asa ne ɛho nkurowa. Aser mma ne: Yimna, Yiswa, Yiswi, Beria ne wɔn nuabaa Sera. Na Beria mma ne: Heber ne Malkiel, ɔne Birsait agya. Na Heber woo Yaflet, Somer, Hotam ne wɔn nuabaa Sua. Na Yaflet mma ne: Pasak, Bimhal ne Aswat. Yeinom ne Yaflet mma. Na Semer mma ne: Ahi ne Rohga, Yehuba ne Aram. Na ne nua Helem mma ne Sofa, Yimna, Seles ne Amal. Sofa mma ne: Suah, Harnefer, Saulo, Beri ne Yimra; Beser, Hod, Sama, Silsa, Yitran ne Beera. Na Yeter mma ne: Yefune, Pispa ne Ara. Na Ula mma ne: Arah, Haniel ne Risia. app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
